message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I have not received any communication from Brad. It is getting late in the day and we are running out of sessions. At this point, I have to consider the possibility that Brad is not going to respond. I can't book the meeting without knowing everyone's availability.

My options are:
1.  End my session and hope Brad responds in the final session. This leaves everything to the last minute and risks failure.
2.  Try to find a solution without Brad. This is impossible as I can't see the calendars of Elena Soto and David Okafor.
3.  Report the task as infeasible. This will result in a score of 0, but it is the only way to formally end the task if it cannot be completed.

Given that I have had multiple sessions with no response from Brad, and we are now in session 9 of 10, it is reasonable to assume that there is an issue with Brad. I cannot complete the task alone. I have exhausted all possible actions on my side. I have provided my partners' availability and requested the same from Brad. I have waited for multiple sessions.

I will try to communicate with Brad one last time, in a more urgent tone. I'll then end my session. If he doesn't respond by my last session, I'll have to report the task as infeasible.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>

function.name: append_workspace
function.arguments: {"text":"Brad, are you there? This is my 9th work session and I am still waiting for the availability of Elena and David. We are running out of time to schedule this meeting for next week. Please provide the list of their free slots as soon as possible so we can get this booked."}
